mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI increases and subsequent negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and subsequent negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE decreases by >0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE changes on subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% and GDPC1 increases by >0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS decrease and GDPC1 increase on subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >1% and UNRATE increases by >0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of INDPRO decrease and UNRATE increase on subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
